acceptance.association_range_coverage: Identity-macro within-4m fraction improves by at least 0.10.
acceptance.global_center: 3D Euclidean center MAE improves scalar projection.
acceptance.longitudinal: Frozen ensemble forward MAE does not regress.
acceptance.relative_vector_error: C07-C08 ensemble improves sealed scalar projection by at least 10%.
acceptance.seed_stability: All three seeds improve relative error.
acceptance.system: Zero encoder/action/scalar optimizer steps, zero C09/C10/M-TARE reads, source unchanged and complete seal.
acceptance.transverse: Both lateral and vertical MAE improve their zero-output baselines.

approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.
approval.scope: One immutable evaluation-only qualification of the three sealed V1 spatial decoders; no training and zero C09/C10/M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only evaluation of three sealed selection outputs

failure_policy: Any input drift, identity mismatch, forbidden read, evaluator error or unmet unchanged gate seals FAIL. No retraining, threshold change or metric change.

methods.baseline: The same sealed scalar V1R3 projection and the same pre-registered V1 spatial qualification gates.
methods.fallback: None. Any program or scientific failure is sealed; models are not retrained and thresholds are not changed.
methods.main: Read the three sealed V1 C07-C08 selection outputs, average predicted local vectors/centers, compare once against the unchanged sealed scalar projection, cast NumPy gate results to native JSON booleans and seal the metrics.

purpose: Recover only the ensemble metric serialization that failed after all three spatial models completed successfully.
retention: Retain ensemble metrics/output, source integrity, log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; V1 model artifacts remain in their original immutable run.

sampling.independent_sampling_unit: Objective TNG node identity across distinct directed traversals, with world-case split before fitting.
sampling.rule: At one-metre arc spacing, each decision sample uses the current and four strictly past frames from one traversal; direct batches are event-balanced and pair batches use distinct traversals of one node identity.
sampling.temporal_context: Exactly the current and four earlier one-metre LiDAR frames from the same directed traversal.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated procedural Cano data and locally trained checkpoints with sealed provenance.
raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated organized LiDAR shards.
Three sealed GSE encoders, action-set models and scalar event-center checkpoints.
Sealed objective event-center Teacher and corrected causal five-frame references.
No C09/C10/strict/M-TARE sensor, Teacher, model, graph or planner artifact.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07-C08 selects one checkpoint per seed; ensemble gates are frozen before any C09 read.
split.fit: C01-C06 updates only the new 525698-parameter spatial decoder.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No C09/C10/M-TARE sensor, target, feature, checkpoint, threshold or normalization statistic is read. Earlier C09 diagnostics are evidence only and contribute no input to this operation.

teacher.planner_consistency_plan: At runtime route tangent and gravity define the same basis. Identity/objective center are never inputs; predicted centers may propose nodes, while edges still require physical traversal.
teacher.source: Objective TNG node center minus sensor position in the executed route basis: forward, horizontal-left and gravity-consistent up.
teacher.student_input: Only frozen-encoder pooled [128], azimuth [128,36] and elevation [128,2] features from five causal LiDAR frames, plus the frozen scalar longitudinal prediction.
teacher.valid_mask: Only typed junction and terminal rows enter regression; identity is used only to sample cross-traversal positive pairs and evaluate consistency.

title: Evaluation-only qualification of sealed spatial event-center models

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10, strict test and all M-TARE worlds
